goal: Improve real TP=1 G11 packed-NVFP4 MoE latency versus flashinfer.trtllm_fp4_block_scale_moe.

source_state.status: reverted to stable source after experiments
source_state.default_path_kept: metadata_valid_slots with linear mid_scale clear and writes

experiments.name: swizzled_only_no_linear_mid_scale
experiments.idea: Skip allocation/clear/write of the unused linear mid_scale tensor and return only mid_q plus mid_scale_swizzled for GEMM2.

observations.note: Runtime-null first attempt passed single correctness.
One short benchmark looked faster, but follow-up checks exposed instability.

observations.failure: Benchmark process reported correctness FAIL with large GEMM2/out errors.
Keeping a full-size dummy linear scale allocation alive did not remove the benchmark correctness failure.

experiments.conclusion: Removing linear mid_scale writes is not stable with the current GEMM2 pipeline. Single-run correctness can pass, but benchmark runs intermittently produce large GEMM2 output corruption.

experiments.name: skip_linear_mid_scale_clear_only
experiments.idea: Keep the original kernel and linear mid_scale writes, but skip the pre-kernel cudaMemsetAsync on the unused linear mid_scale tensor.

correctness_result.note: Single skip-bench correctness passed versus FlashInfer.

bench_result.failure: Benchmark process reported correctness FAIL with large GEMM2/out errors.

experiments.conclusion: The linear mid_scale clear appears to be required for stable current end-to-end behavior, even though GEMM2 only consumes mid_scale_swizzled.

experiments.name: old_metadata_path_recheck
experiments.conclusion: The original metadata path with linear mid_scale clear and writes remains the stable default.

recommended_next_steps: Do not skip linear mid_scale clear or writes in the current staged pipeline.

If revisiting this area, first localize why GEMM2/out can corrupt when the unused linear scale traffic is removed; suspect hidden memory-layout, allocator, or generated GEMM2 out-of-bounds sensitivity rather than numerical mismatch.
For meaningful speedup, focus on GEMM2/final-scatter fusion or a stable faster GEMM2 epilogue; SwiGLU scale-memory micro-optimizations are too small and currently unstable.
